title: Finch Circle Late Credit — Card Account Standing Share Decision Table
content:
**Rule.** In a late credit of Finch Circle Loyalty Program points on a missing-points request, the late-credit standing share is the whole (1) when the charged card account is active and shows no returned payment dated within the last 6 whole months before the request date, one half (0.5) when the account is active and shows such a returned payment, and none (0) when the account is not active.

The charged card account is the card account named on the claimed unit's purchase record. Its status and its returned payments (payments that came back unpaid, among the account transactions) are read from that account under Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards.

## Decision table

| Charged card account status | Returned payment dated within the last 6 whole months before the request date | Late-credit standing share |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | 1 |
| active | one or more | 0.5 |
| not active (for example restricted or closed) | any | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Request on 20 September; the account is active and its only returned payment is dated in January of the same year, more than 6 whole months earlier: share 1.
- Same account, but a payment returned in August: share 0.5.
- The account was closed before the request: share 0.
